model_annotation: Figure 10 is a grouped bar chart illustrating the effect of context masking on case tasks, categorized by language family. The horizontal axis lists ten language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled “effect,” ranges from 0 to 30 with tick marks at intervals of 10, and error bars are shown for each bar to indicate standard deviation. For each language family, six colored bars represent different multilingual BERT models: mBERT-L2 (blue), XLM-L2 (green), mBERT-R2 (red), XLM-R2 (dark red), mBERT-B2 (light blue), and XLM-B2 (purple). The height of each bar indicates the magnitude of the masking effect, with values generally ranging from near 0 to approximately 25. The tallest bars appear for the IE-Indic and IE-Romance families, particularly for the XLM-R2 and XLM-B2 models, while the shortest bars are observed for the Isolate and Semitic families across most models. The chart is unsorted, with language families appearing in a fixed order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and error bars.
